title: Study mode and global presence
content: Stardom University delivers 100% Flexible Online Education (an international online university — students can study from anywhere). The university has branches/offices in four countries: Turkey (Istanbul), the United States (Sacramento, CA), the United Kingdom (London), and Egypt (Cairo). Programs are organized into seven academic faculties: Business Administration, IT and Computing, Education, Media and Electronic Publishing, Legal Studies, Arts and Languages, and Islamic Studies.

title: Faculties / Schools at Stardom University
content: Stardom University's seven academic faculties are: Faculty of Business Administration, Faculty of IT and Computing, Faculty of Education, Faculty of Media and Electronic Publishing, Faculty of Legal Studies, Faculty of Arts and Languages, and Faculty of Islamic Studies. The university offers 41 Bachelor's Degree Programs, 47 Master's Degree Programs, 37 Doctoral Degree Programs (as stated by the university; the University's own program-listing page enumerates 36 named doctoral titles), and 9 Higher Diploma Programs.

title: Admission requirements vary by study level
content: Admission requirements at Stardom University vary by level of study. Undergraduate (Bachelor's): High School Certificate or equivalent, identification documents, and a passport-sized photograph. Master's: a Bachelor's Degree, official academic transcript, and identification documents. Doctorate: a Master's Degree, academic transcript, and a research proposal where applicable. The Admissions Team can help with program selection, admission requirements, credit transfer, tuition fees, scholarships, technical support, and questions from international applicants.

title: Documents required to apply, by degree level
content: Required documents generally include: High School Certificate or equivalent (Bachelor's applicants), Bachelor's Degree certificate (Master's applicants), Master's Degree certificate (Doctoral applicants), official Academic Transcripts, a valid Passport or National ID, a recent passport-sized photograph, and an English Language Certificate if applicable to the program.

title: How to apply — the 8-step process
content: The published application process: (1) Submit the online application form with personal/academic info and selected program; (2) Upload required documents; (3) Application review by the Admissions Team (you may be contacted by email for more info); (4) An admission interview if required for the selected program; (5) Receive an official Admission Offer by email (program details, tuition, payment instructions, enrollment deadlines, Student Portal info); (6) Complete tuition payment per the approved schedule (flexible payment plans may be available); (7) Final enrollment — Student ID, university email, LMS access, Student Handbook, orientation info; (8) Begin the learning journey — virtual classrooms, digital learning resources, academic advising, career services. Final admission decisions are made by Stardom University, not by this assistant.

title: Tuition fee structure
content: Stardom University uses one unified, semester-based tuition system for all academic levels: USD 1,000 per semester for Bachelor's, Higher Diploma, Master's, and Doctoral programs. Estimated total program cost: Bachelor's (8 semesters) ≈ USD 8,000; Higher Diploma (3 semesters) ≈ USD 3,000; Master's (4 semesters) ≈ USD 4,000; Doctorate (4 semesters) ≈ USD 4,000. Up to 3 academic semesters can run per year, which can shorten time to graduation. Tuition is paid semester-by-semester before each new semester begins — no full-program advance payment is required. Tuition includes: academic courses, LMS access, a university email account, digital library resources, academic advising, student support services, and free workshops/training sessions. Payment methods: bank transfer, credit/debit cards, and online payment gateways.

title: Application fee
content: A one-time, non-refundable application fee of USD 150 applies to all applicants, at every academic level: Bachelor's, Higher Diploma, Master's, and Doctoral (PhD). It is paid once, at the time of application.

title: Scholarships and financial aid
content: Stardom University offers several scholarship and tuition-support initiatives, including: Merit-Based Scholarships, Social Responsibility Scholarships, Humanitarian Support Scholarships, Regional Educational Initiatives, Special Admission Campaigns, Strategic Partnership Scholarships, Professional Development Scholarships, and Community Impact Initiatives. Students from countries affected by humanitarian crises, armed conflict, or exceptional national circumstances may be eligible for tuition discounts of up to 30%. Eligibility can be based on academic achievement, country of residence, humanitarian circumstances, strategic partnership agreements, or program-specific criteria. Availability, terms, and amounts vary by intake and should be confirmed with an admissions advisor.

title: Accreditation and recognition
content: Stardom University holds a range of international recognitions and accreditations, including: Times Higher Education Impact Rankings 2025 (1501+ category) and listing on the UNIRANKS global ranking platform; academic accreditation from the European Organization for Education (EOEA), the International Association for Quality Assurance (QAHE), the Accreditation Commission for Online Higher Education (ACOHE), the International Education Compliance Network (IECN), the Qualifications and Examinations Accreditation Network (QEAN), and the International Accreditation Organization (IAO); government-level recognition via the UK Register of Learning Providers (UKRLP), California's Bureau for Private Postsecondary Education (BPPE), and accreditation from the Sudanese Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (in partnership with Al-Qalam College of Science and Technology), plus an MOU with Luxor University; quality-standard certifications via UK Education Quality Management (UKEQM) and ISO 9001:2015, ISO 29993:2017, and ISO 21001:2018 (via the International Accreditation Council); CPD accreditation from the CPD Certification Service and The CPD Group; and registration on the United Nations Global Marketplace (UNGM). Country-specific degree recognition/equivalency (whether a particular country's ministry of education will recognize a Stardom degree) is NOT something this assistant can confirm — that always requires human confirmation from the admissions team, since recognition rules vary by country and change over time.

title: Degree authentication
content: Stardom University states that the integrity and authenticity of academic qualifications are fundamental to its quality assurance and institutional commitments, and it maintains a degree authentication process. Specific authentication procedures (e.g. how a third party verifies a Stardom degree) should be requested from the university's official Degree Authentication page or the Admissions Department directly.

title: International student requirements
content: Stardom University welcomes students from around the world as a fully online, international university — students study from anywhere with no geographical limitations. International applicants follow the same streamlined online admission process and are required to submit: academic qualifications, official academic transcripts, a valid passport or national identification, a recent passport-sized photograph, and English language proof where applicable. All applications are reviewed individually by the Admissions Office. Because programs are delivered 100% online, country-specific visa requirements generally do not apply the way they would for an in-person program — but any visa-related question should be routed to a human advisor rather than answered definitively by this assistant.

title: Authorized admissions agent for this assistant
content: The way to reach a human admissions advisor for this assistant is via WhatsApp: Weam Sabri, the authorized admissions agent representing Stardom University's admissions process for prospective students, reachable on WhatsApp at +90 553 704 5811. Always give this contact — and only this contact — whenever a student wants to speak with a human, needs help beyond what verified information can answer, or is ready to move forward with an application.
